criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: a test where the planner revises then accepts shows the second planner prompt contains the first finding's text, and the job lands.
criteria.evidence: after_a_revise_the_second_planner_prompt_quotes_the_first_finding_and_the_job_lands passed. It asserts the second planner brief contains the finding text, the 'Revision: your plan for round 1' heading and the previous plan's approach. It also asserts the job ends Landed, the role order is Reader, Planner, Critic, Planner, Critic, Producer, Verifier, and check_history is clean.

criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: a test where every round says revise asserts no producer or verifier invocation, outcome failed with reason starting 'planning stopped before any code was written:' plus the findings, three plans and three critiques committed, totals counting all six planning invocations, verification_passed unknown (not false), and check_history() clean.
criteria.evidence: when_every_round_says_revise_... passed. It asserts: state is Failed; the reason starts with the required prefix and contains the finding and 'round 3 of 3'; Producer plus Verifier count is 0; job-plan-1..3 and critique-1..3 are committed in HEAD with no candidate or verification record; totals.invocations == 7 (the reader plus six planning calls); the verification_passes score event outcome is None; check_history has no violations. The athena-score change is what makes the outcome None (it was Some(false) before), so this test would fail without it.

criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: a plan editing an unlisted athena.toml, or citing a command outside the verifier's grant (per athena_agent::policy::evaluate), yields an Athena critique with a major finding and zero critic invocations.
criteria.evidence: Both tests passed: a_plan_that_edits_an_unlisted_governance_file_... and a_plan_citing_a_command_outside_the_verifiers_grant_.... Each asserts that critique-1 has invocation_seq None, one major finding with source Athena that names athena.toml or `python3 check_greeting.py`, and that the critic is called only for round 2's plan.

criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: a retry of a job stopped in planning carries the last critique's findings into the new reading's brief via earlier_attempt.
criteria.evidence: a_retry_of_a_job_stopped_in_planning_carries_the_last_critiques_findings passed. The retry's reader prompt contains '# Earlier attempt' and the round-3 finding, and does not contain the round-1 finding. The code is in reading.rs carry(): it quotes the findings and any misread of the last critique that did not accept.

criteria.criterion: Athena checks cover: exactly one demonstration per criterion; behavior demos have fails_without and an allowed command; modify paths exist and create paths do not; governance paths use admission::is_governance and governance_change_is_listed (major otherwise); other unlisted paths are minor findings.
criteria.evidence: Read admission::plan_findings in the diff. It covers each of these checks as listed, calls evaluate() with the verifier's grant as a Policy, and also flags demonstrations whose criterion number is out of range. run.rs sends any blocker or major finding back without a critic call. Tests cover each check, and a minor finding does not send the plan back.

criteria.criterion: Rounds are bounded by max_rounds (default 3); reject, a misread reading, or revise in the last round stops the job; the revision brief quotes the previous plan and every finding.
criteria.evidence: In run.rs, plan_round loops for round in 1..=max_rounds. max_rounds already existed in config.rs with default 3. end_round stops on a misread, on reject, and on revise when last_round. Otherwise it returns a PlanRevision holding the previous plan and every finding, which the existing planner_brief renders. The test a_reject_a_misread_reading_or_a_revise_in_the_last_round_stops_the_job covers all three stops.

findings.summary: Two changed files are not on the expected-deliverables list: crates/athena-score/src/lib.rs and docs/design/job-planning.md.
findings.evidence: The athena-score change is needed to satisfy F11: the verification_passes event must score as unknown for a job stopped in planning. The test asserts this. The design doc gains a 5-line 'Built as' note. Both are small and justified, but neither is on the list.

findings.summary: The 'stopped in planning' rule in scoring is inferred from which roles ran, not from the outcome reason.
findings.evidence: Any dispatched job with planner or critic invocations, no producer or verifier, and no verification scores as unknown. That includes a job whose plan was accepted but which then failed before the producer ran (for example a pin failure). This is arguably still correct, since no code was written.

summary: The change does what job 4 asks, and all 8 criteria are met; I recommend it passes. Planning now runs up to max_rounds rounds (default 3). A revise sends the planner a brief that quotes the previous plan and every finding. Reject, a misread reading, or a revise in the last round stops the job with the reason "planning stopped before any code was written:" followed by the findings. A stopped job's verification result scores as unknown, not false, and a retry carries the last critique's findings (both from review F11). Before each critic call, the new admission::plan_findings runs Athena's own checks at no model cost; a major finding sends the plan back without calling the critic. I ran the 15 tests in the job_plan test file, the xtask tests, clippy and fmt check: all passed, and the new tests cover each path. athena.toml is untouched and CHANGELOG.md has an entry. One minor finding: two changed files are outside the deliverables list. The scoring change in athena-score is needed for F11; the other is a short note added to the design doc.
